title: ECM modeling and performance tuning of SpMV and Lattice QCD on A64FX

passages.note: The university investigators identify their FX1000 test platform as A64FX, report Armv8.2-A with 512-bit SVE, and describe compiling and running SVE code.
The in-core microbenchmarks report reciprocal throughput of 0.5 cycles for a standard SVE ld1d load on A64FX. The experiments use 2.2 GHz unless otherwise specified.
